reviews.review: It really starts to pick up as you approach 200 hours.

This game is great! It is a free-to-play with constant updates to keep the game constantly changing and evolving. The graphics are beautiful and the Evolution Engine they use allows the game to run smoothly. The community this game has made is always so inclusive to new players and are always so nice. Overall, its a free game from a great company that never fails to impress new and old players alike. 

10/10 Best Free Game
Meh, good but gets boring after a while.

I've been playing this game since August 2016 till December 2016 in that time reached rank 21 
Its fine and good for a while and if you are not hard core this game is a decent fun. Do not expect to play for long unless you are planing to spend your money on ingame currency however since without it you will be experiencing a demo version. Its not a fair free to play model with only cosmetics being available for currency.

Now if you are like myself and if the game is decent you want to play more and more of it here are the words of caution. Every update since august made the game worse. The game is quickly moving to complete trash status. By that I mean in already heavy grind game they introducing new insane and mindless grind. For example latest update requires you either fork over real life money for content or spend 10+ hours farming the same mission just for a single peace of equipment and that's disregarding the side grinding for materials. Another newly released equipment requires a material that would take hundreds if not thousands man hours to farm just to unlock it or you could instantly unlock it with a credit card. 

I will not spend my time with pay to win game. I am not ok with this system. I also dont recommend you support extortion as a business practice. Due to this I am going to be playing something else, I recommend you do the same.

Apart form that the game on PC is bug ridden. Its even has a fan made nickname Bugframe. Spending 20 minutes in a mission and then loosing all rewards due to bugs is common place. Bugs associated with group play are numerous. Community is riddled with profanity spewing people it is so bad that I completely disabled ingame voice chat and have numerous people on ignore list due to harassment. Instead of fixing the game mostly developers focus on releasing new content. Every time anything new is released it introduces numerous new or old bugs into the game and usually makes the game unplayable for a day or two. PvP is the worst I have ever played. Game completely lacks any sort of tutorial and has many systems that you will not know exist unless you go look for guides on youtune or wiki which may or may not be even relevant anymore due to game being constantly updated.

In closing what I want to say the game has a huge ammount of problems and over time it doesnt get better but instead gets worse.
pretty adictive, but u dont get to far without anyone to play with
